items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: I start with Thomas. When Thomas come here. I didn't go get him. He came here to me.

ctx.x: Well I told you that once. Because I tell you why. They used to call me Turk. Turkey Buzzard. Turkey Buzzard. Why? I used to name him Dark and Hansel. But man when I started to pick on that bass. Them cats let me go. I used to sit down. Everybody used to play the piano. I said. Now I'm going to get me something different. I said. Let me play a little piece once in a while. He said. No man. I said. I just got you. Well I said. I'm going to get me something to myself. I got on and I prayed. I said. Lord. What can I…
When did you start with Thomas. When did you start with Thomas.

I start with Thomas. When Thomas come here. I didn't go get him. He came here to me. And he came here around in 19 and. Around in 15. And that's when you started. Around in the 1915. September storm. Right about a year after that. I can't remember. Because when this cat come through here with that. I had a little brother. And he used to beat on a tube. You know. And this cat here used to be. Thomas. I was. Boy. My brother. He died. You know. And I said. We was going to be some great musicians. I said. We ain't…
